name: AI origin and responsibility — public reference card

isBasedOn.name: 誰の問いがAIを動かすのか──起源と責任の交差点

description: Public, non-canonical machine-readable discovery card derived from Nakagawa Master's canonical theory on AI question origin and responsibility. The canonical source remains authoritative.

mainEntity.name: When AI produces an answer, where does responsibility begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: A useful analysis traces the causal chain backward from the visible output, distinguishing the initiating origin, material human and machine transformations, prior sources or theories, and the accountable relationships among the actors and decisions that shaped the result.
